A field guide to page snapshots

The first paragraph explains why a stored copy drifts away from the page it came from.

The second paragraph notes that a quote is the only stable anchor left once the original markup is gone.

What changes when a page is revised

Editors move sections around, and a paragraph that used to be third becomes eighth without changing a single word.

  • Lists keep their items but not their neighbours.
  • A code block below is copied verbatim.
  • Quotes survive revisions better than layout does.
const anchor = resolveSnapshotAnchor(text, body)

A snapshot is a promise about a moment, and the moment has already passed by the time anyone reads it again.
